system.description:
FOLKWARDEN HEALING SOUL UTILITY
Folkwarden Specialist Spell
Cast 10 minutes (material, somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets 1 living creature

You prepare a complex restorative working using nine herbs, roots, fungi, minerals or equivalent substances whose individual importance varies wildly between Folkwarden traditions.
Select one Disease or Poison currently affecting the target and attempt to Counteract it.
After resolving the Counteract attempt, the target may also choose one of the following:
reduce Fatigued by 1d6;
reduce Sickened by 1d6; or
reduce Weakened by 1d6; or
reduce Injured by 1d4.
A condition cannot be reduced below 0.
The secondary benefit occurs regardless of whether the Counteract attempt succeeds, provided the spell itself was successfully cast.
Nine-Herb Restoration cannot restore HP, remove Dying, reverse physical injury or cure an affliction that is not actually a Disease or Poison.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: The target may select two different secondary benefits.
+2 PP: Target an additional creature.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. The Counteract is rolled against a disease or poison on the target; then the target chooses its reduction, rolled and applied.
